lead: Amitabh Bachchan is best known as an Indian film actor, born on 11 October 1942 in Prayagraj.
As of 2026, he is 83 years old, and his birth date places him under the Libra sign.
He has 60 credited works on public record and has held the office of Member of the Lok Sabha and Member of the 8th Lok Sabha.

sections.heading: Amitabh Bachchan — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Amitabh Bachchan was born on 11 October 1942 in Prayagraj, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Harivansh Rai Bachchan and his mother, Teji Bachchan. He is a sibling of Ajitabh Bachchan.
His listed education includes Sherwood College, Kirori Mal College, Boys' High School & College and Post Graduate Government College – 11, Chandigarh.
He is recorded as speaking Hindi and English.

sections.heading: Amitabh Bachchan — Career and Professional Work
paras: Amitabh Bachchan works primarily as a film actor, film producer, singer, television actor and writer.
He has held the following offices: Member of the Lok Sabha (1984–1987) and Member of the 8th Lok Sabha.
